# Contactous

> Contactous provides production-ready APIs for calculating organizational carbon emissions across Scope 1, Scope 2, and Scope 3 activities.

Contactous simplifies carbon footprint estimation by providing programmatic APIs, Google Sheets functions, API clustering, dynamic calculation explanations, and an MCP server for AI-native integrations.

## Documentation

- [Getting Started](/getting_started): Introduction to using Contactous APIs.
- [Audience and Intent](/audience_and_intent): Contactous's purpose, capabilities, and target users.
- [API Reference](/api): Complete OpenAPI reference for Contactous APIs.
- [API Playground](/api-playground): Explore and test Contactous APIs interactively.

## Estimation APIs

- [Flights](/estimation_apis/flights): Estimate emissions from air travel.
- [Hotels](/estimation_apis/hotels): Estimate emissions from hotel stays.
- [Vehicles by Type](/estimation_apis/vehicle/vehicle_by_type): Estimate vehicle emissions by vehicle type.
- [Vehicles by Model](/estimation_apis/vehicle/vehicles_by_model): Estimate vehicle emissions by vehicle model.
- [Freight and Shipments](/estimation_apis/freight_and_shipments): Estimate freight and shipment emissions.
- [eCommerce](/estimation_apis/ecommerce): Estimate emissions associated with eCommerce shipments.
- [Fuel](/estimation_apis/fuel): Estimate emissions from fuel consumption.
- [Electricity](/estimation_apis/electricity): Estimate emissions from electricity consumption.

## Supplementary APIs

- [Airport Search by Keyword](/supplementary_apis/Airports/airport_search_by_keyword): Search for airports using keywords.
- [Distance Between Two Airports](/supplementary_apis/Airports/distance_between_two_airports): Calculate distance between airports.
- [Nearest Airport from Another Airport](/supplementary_apis/Airports/nearest_airport_from_another_airport): Find the nearest airport to another airport.
- [Nearest Airport from Postal Code](/supplementary_apis/Airports/nearest_airport_from_postal_code): Find the nearest airport using a postal code.
- [List of Models by Vehicle Maker](/supplementary_apis/Vehicles/list_of_models_of_vehicle_maker): Retrieve vehicle models by manufacturer.
- [List of Vehicle Makers](/supplementary_apis/Vehicles/list_of_vehicle_makers): Retrieve supported vehicle manufacturers.

## Special APIs

- [Singapore Emission Factors Registry](/special_apis/singapore_emission_factor_registry): Access Singapore emission factor data.
- [GHG Equivalencies](/special_apis/ghg_equivalencies): Convert emissions into common GHG equivalencies.
- [Estimated Flight Time](/special_apis/estimated_flight_time): Estimate flight time between airports.

## Integrations

- [Google Sheet Functions](/google_sheet_functions): Calculate emissions directly from Google Sheets.
- [MCP Server](/mcp_server): Integrate Contactous with AI assistants and autonomous agents.
